Announcement

SwiftAxis International operated both Air and Sea shipment

18 November 2026

Shipping from all angles from Ghana and into Ghana.

Read more

SwiftAxis International Limited provides both air and sea freight, giving businesse and individuals a fast, dependable way to move goods in and out of Ghana. Whether you need urgent delivery by air or cost-effective shipping by sea, our team handles the booking, documentation, customs clearing, and delivery from start to finish. You choose the speed and budget that suit your cargo, and we make sure it arrives safely and on time.

Announcement

Prices that fit your budget

18 November 2026

Bring your Cargo and we'll find the right price for you.

Read more

Our prices depend on what you are shipping and how you want it to travel. For air freight, the cost is based on the weight and size of your cargo and how fast you need it. For sea freight, it depends on whether you ship by container or by volume. The destination, type of goods, and customs clearing also affect the price. We keep our rates fair and clear, with no hidden charges, and send you a full quote before anything ships. Contact us on WhatsApp or by email with the details of your cargo to get yours

Announcement

Swift Clearance and Delivery

18 November 2026

Bring your Cargo and we'll find the right price for you.

Read more

SwiftAxis International Limited handles customs clearance at Tema Port for sea cargo and at Kotoka International Airport for air cargo, so your goods move through without delays. Our team prepares and submits the documents, pays the duties and port charges, and follows your shipment until it is released. We keep you updated at every step, then deliver straight to your door. Whether you are importing or exporting, you can leave the paperwork and the waiting to us

About SwiftAxis

SwiftAxis International Limited is a logistics company based in Accra, Ghana. We provide freight forwarding, customs clearing, warehousing, and door-to-door delivery for businesses and individuals.
